# Verbs whose h is aspirated ("h aspiré"), so je does not elide before them:
# "je hais", "je hurle". Any other verb starting with h has a silent h and
# elides like a vowel: "j'habite", "j'hésite".
#
# Hand-kept, not generated by tool/lefff. One infinitive per line, spelled
# exactly as the key in verbs_*.json. Pronominal entries are left out: their
# answers start with "me"/"m'" and never elide.
